verdict.rationale: Apple's M5 ships in fanless iPad Pro and thin, fanless-adjacent MacBook Pro designs with documented all-day battery claims (up to 24 hours video streaming) and community benchmarks confirming real-world performance/efficiency gains over M4. Community discussion corroborates strong CPU efficiency and performance-per-watt improvements, consistent with Apple's power-efficiency-first chip design philosophy. missing for 10: independent third-party battery-life testing (e.g., reviewer runtime benchmarks) and explicit fanless-design confirmation for the specific M5 MacBook Pro SKU.
